data.content:
Implemented the Markdoc 0.2.0 source compatibility fix.

Added a local `isTag` type guard and updated the docs Markdoc renderer/content pipeline to treat only real Markdoc `Tag` objects as renderable elements. This handles the broader `RenderableTreeNode` shape introduced in 0.2.0 while preserving the frontend bundle behavior by using a type-only Markdoc import. No test files were modified.
